newsitem.title: USA: Zurich Insurance close to deal - NYT. [CORRECTED 04:06 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Zurich Insurance close to deal - NYT. [CORRECTED 04:06 GMT]

text.p: Zurich Insurance Group (corrects from Zurich Reinsurance Centre) is near a deal to acquire the privately held money management firm of Scudder, Stevens & Clark for an estimated $1.5 billion, the New York Times said.

In Friday's edition, the Times said the move would demonstrate the Swiss insurance company's effort to broaden its asset management expertise and to offer a complement to its Zurich Kemper Investments subsidiary to bolster that unit's performance.
The newspapers cited unnamed sources with knowledge of the talks.

"There are discussions going on to form a strategic alliance to create a world-class investment organization, which would offer clients Kemper's brokerage capability, Scudder's asset management and Zurich Insurance's global reach," one unnamed source said.
Scudder has about $115 billion in assets under management. About a month ago, it retained Goldman, Sachs & Co to help it find ways to bolster its value and to possibly find a buyer.
Several institutions have recently been mentioned as possible suitors, including Union Bank of Switzerland SBGZ.S, Chase Manhattan Corp and First Union Corp.
